verdict.rationale: The full-application end of the story is evidenced. Svelte compiles standalone components (svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-4), and SvelteKit scales up to full apps, SPAs and static sites, positioned like Next or Nuxt (svelte-docs-16, svelte-docs-17, svelte-docs-18). Nothing in the pack shows mounting Svelte into a small part of an existing page or adopting it gradually inside a non-Svelte app. missing for 10: documented embedding/mounting of components into part of an existing page, an explicit incremental-adoption/migration path, independent corroboration of gradual adoption.
